facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland first-home buyers who understand what to look for at open homes consistently avoid overpaying and find the right property with confidence before the winter market shifts
facebook.post_text:
Most first-home buyers walk into open homes without a plan — and it costs them. 🏡

You fall in love with the kitchen, miss the damp in the hallway, and make an offer based on emotion rather than evidence. It happens more than you'd think.

👉 Builders reports are not optional — they are your negotiation tool
👉 Ask why the owners are selling — the answer tells you more than the listing ever will
👉 Visit twice: once for the feeling, once for the detail

The homes that look perfect at first glance are not always the ones that perform best as investments. 💡

✔️ Know your non-negotiables before you walk through the door
✔️ Compare recent East Auckland sales in the same street before you bid
✔️ Bring a trusted advisor — not just a friend who likes houses

Buying your first home in East Auckland is one of the biggest decisions you will ever make. You deserve to walk in prepared, not just excited.
